    {"id": "ic8", "text": "Every qb:componentProperty on a qb:SliceKey must also be declared as a qb:component of the associated qb:DataStructureDefinition.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "Every `qb:componentProperty` on a `qb:SliceKey` must also be declared as a `qb:component` of the associated `qb:DataStructureDefinition`.", "location": "IC-8"},
    {"id": "ic9", "text": "Each qb:Slice must have exactly one associated qb:sliceStructure.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "Each `qb:Slice` must have exactly one associated `qb:sliceStructure`.", "location": "IC-9"},
    {"id": "ic10", "text": "Every qb:Slice must have a value for every dimension declared in its qb:sliceStructure.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "Every `qb:Slice` must have a value for every dimension declared in its `qb:sliceStructure`.", "location": "IC-10"},
    {"id": "ic11", "text": "Every qb:Observation has a value for each dimension declared in its associated qb:DataStructureDefinition.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "Every `qb:Observation` has a value for each dimension declared in its associated `qb:DataStructureDefinition`.", "location": "IC-11"},
    {"id": "ic12", "text": "No two qb:Observations in the same qb:DataSet may have the same value for all dimensions.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "No two `qb:Observation`s in the same `qb:DataSet` may have the same value for all dimensions.", "location": "IC-12"},
    {"id": "ic13", "text": "Every qb:Observation has a value for each declared attribute that is marked as required.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "Every `qb:Observation` has a value for each declared attribute that is marked as required.", "location": "IC-13"},
    {"id": "ic14", "text": "In a qb:DataSet which does not use a Measure dimension each qb:Observation must have a value for every declared measure.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "In a `qb:DataSet` which does not use a Measure dimension then each individual `qb:Observation` must have a value for every declared measure.", "location": "IC-14"},
    {"id": "ic15", "text": "In a qb:DataSet which uses a Measure dimension each qb:Observation must have a value for the measure corresponding to its qb:measureType.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "In a `qb:DataSet` which uses a Measure dimension then each `qb:Observation` must have a value for the measure corresponding to its given `qb:measureType`.", "location": "IC-15"},
    {"id": "ic16", "text": "In a measure-dimension qb:DataSet each qb:Observation must only have a value for one measure.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "In a `qb:DataSet` which uses a Measure dimension then each `qb:Observation` must only have a value for one measure (by IC-15 this will be the measure corresponding to its `qb:measureType`).", "location": "IC-16"},
    {"id": "ic17", "text": "In a measure-dimension cube every populated non-measure dimension point must have observations for each declared measure.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "In a `qb:DataSet` which uses a Measure dimension then if there is a Observation for some combination of non-measure dimensions then there must be other Observations with the same non-measure dimension values for each of the declared measures.", "location": "IC-17"},
    {"id": "ic18", "text": "If a DataSet D has a qb:slice S with a qb:observation O then O's qb:dataSet must be D.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "If a `qb:DataSet` D has a `qb:slice` S, and S has an `qb:observation` O, then the `qb:dataSet` corresponding to O must be D.", "location": "IC-18"},
    {"id": "ic19", "text": "If a dimension property has a qb:codeList, its value on every qb:Observation must be in the code list.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "If a dimension property has a `qb:codeList`, then the value of the dimension property on every `qb:Observation` must be in the code list.", "location": "IC-19"},
    {"id": "ic20", "text": "For a HierarchicalCodeList with a non-blank parentChildProperty, dimension values must be reachable from a hierarchy root along that property.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "If a dimension property has a `qb:HierarchicalCodeList` with a non-blank `qb:parentChildProperty` then the value of that dimension property on every `qb:Observation` must be reachable from a root of the hierarchy using zero or more hops along the `qb:parentChildProperty` links.", "location": "IC-20"},
    {"id": "ic21", "text": "For a HierarchicalCodeList with an inverse parentChildProperty, dimension values must be reachable from a hierarchy root along the inverse property.", "response_type": "boolean", "tier": "public", "grounding_span": "If a dimension property has a `qb:HierarchicalCodeList` with an inverse `qb:parentChildProperty` then the value of that dimension property on every `qb:Observation` must be reachable from a root of the hierarchy using zero or more hops along the inverse `qb:parentChildProperty` links.", "location": "IC-21"}

  "practices": [
    {"id": "p-use-dcterms", "text": "Use Dublin Core Terms for the key metadata annotations of DataSets.", "as_of_date": "2014-01-16", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Dublin Core Terms [DC11] *SHOULD* be used for representing the key metadata annotations commonly needed for DataSets.", "location": "9"},
    {"id": "p-use-rdfs-label", "text": "Give rdfs:label and rdfs:comment for DataSets in addition to Dublin Core terms.", "as_of_date": "2014-01-16", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "The RDFS terms for display label (`rdfs:label`) descriptive comment (`rdfs:comment`) *SHOULD* be given as well for compatibility with earlier versions of Data Cube and common RDF practice.", "location": "9"},
    {"id": "p-use-skos-codes", "text": "Represent individual code values with skos:Concept and the admissible-value set with skos:ConceptScheme or skos:Collection.", "as_of_date": "2014-01-16", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "In those cases we recommend use of SKOS, representing the individual code values using `skos:Concept` and the overall set of admissible values using `skos:ConceptScheme` or `skos:Collection`.", "location": "8.1"},
    {"id": "p-declare-code-class", "text": "When developing a code list also create a Class denoting all its codes so ranges can be checked by generic RDF tools.", "as_of_date": "2014-01-16", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "It is convenient and good practice when developing a code list to also create a Class to denote all the codes within the code list, irrespective of hierarchical structure.", "location": "8.1"},
    {"id": "p-hierarchical-skos-narrower", "text": "Represent hierarchical code lists using skos:narrower or a sub-property of it.", "as_of_date": "2014-01-16", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Hierarchical code lists *SHOULD* be represented using the `skos:narrower` relationship, or a sub-property of it, to link from the `skos:hasTopConcept` codes down through the tree or lattice of child codes.", "location": "8.2"},
    {"id": "p-prefer-skos-over-hcl", "text": "Where a code list is already available as a SKOS concept scheme or collection, use SKOS directly rather than qb:HierarchicalCodeList.", "as_of_date": "2014-01-16", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "In the case where a code list is already available as a SKOS concept scheme or collection, or could reasonable me made so, then those *SHOULD* be used directly.", "location": "8.3"},
    {"id": "p-dct-subject", "text": "Use dct:subject to record a whole-dataset classification into statistical domains.", "as_of_date": "2014-01-16", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "We encourage use of `dct:subject` to record such a classification of a whole data set.", "location": "9.1"},
    {"id": "p-dct-publisher", "text": "Use dct:publisher and represent the publishing organization as a foaf:Agent or org:Organization.", "as_of_date": "2014-01-16", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Again we recommend use of the Dublin Core term `dct:publisher` for this. The organization should be represented as an instance of `foaf:Agent`, or some more specific subclass such as `org:Organization` [ORG].", "location": "9.2"},
    {"id": "p-http-uris", "text": "Name entities and concepts with dereferenceable HTTP URIs so consumers can look them up.", "as_of_date": "2014-01-16", "scope": "content", "grounding_span": "The approach [LOD] recommends use of HTTP URIs to name the entities and concepts so that consumers of the data can look-up those URIs to get more information, including links to other related URIs.", "location": "2.1"},
    {"id": "p-normalized-preferred", "text": "Prefer normalized representations as they are generally easier to query and combine.", "as_of_date": "2014-01-16", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "however normalized representations are in general easier to query and combine.", "location": "6.4"}
